# Slatech Solutions

> Slatech Solutions is a digital product and software development company based in Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria, founded in 2020. It designs and builds websites, e-commerce platforms, custom software, web applications, mobile apps and cloud infrastructure for businesses in Nigeria and internationally.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2020
- Founder & CEO: Olalekan Akindiya
- Headquarters: 2b, Olaide Tomori, Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria
- Phone / WhatsApp: 08076172456 (+2348076172456)
- Website design pricing: from ₦150,000 for a landing page, up to ₦1M+ for larger sites
- Serves: businesses across Nigeria and internationally
